title: Second-Order Low-Pass Filter (Discrete or Continuous)
text: Discrete-time or continuous-time second-order low-pass filter, 1 input, 1 output, {Sample time (-1 for inherited)} sets Block sample time; {Coefficient of s, A1} sets the a1 coefficient, {Coefficient of s^2, A2} sets the a2 coefficient, {Initialization} sets the initial state specification Inherited from block and {Initial state}. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initialization
params.values: Initial state specification Inherited from block input (default) | Specify as parameter
